cases.root_cause: icalreqstattype_from_string stores a pointer to a temporary ring buffer (via icalmemory_tmp_copy) in the stat.debug field of the returned icalreqstattype struct. This struct is embedded in an icalvalue and persists. Later, when icalproperty_get_value_as_string adds its result buffer to the same global temporary buffer ring (icalmemory_add_tmp_buffer), the ring wraps around and frees the older stat.debug buffer. Subsequent calls to icalreqstattype_as_string_r read the freed stat.debug pointer during snprintf, causing the use-after-free.

cases.root_cause: In pcre2_auto_possess.c, get_chr_property_list reads character operands via GETCHARINCTEST from the code pointer without verifying the pointer remains within the allocated compiled-code buffer. When auto_possessify processes a repeat opcode (e.g., OP_STAR) whose subsequent opcode is a character opcode (e.g., OP_CHAR) at the very end of the buffer, get_chr_property_list is called with code pointing to that character opcode; after incrementing past the opcode byte, GETCHARINCTEST reads the character operand from one byte past the buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read (CWE-122).
